title: Metadata, Data Quality & Cleaning
topicSummary: Metadata, context and provenance; keyed data combination; missing, invalid, repeated and inconsistent data; documented cleaning and responsible collection.
homeworkInstructions: 12 original questions, 30 classroom marks, about 40 minutes. Q5 requires exactly two selections. Explain every cleaning decision; retain unusual values unless evidence justifies a change. Use the synthetic commute dataset and its stated rules.
